world: After an unexplained global catastrophe, scattered human settlements survive beneath an unstable sky: ruined cities, scarce water and power, strange creatures. Action is non-graphic.
premise: A second sun appears in the sky and every settlement receives the same unexplained countdown. Han Doyun, a resourceful 19-year-old scavenger who avoids leadership, is forced to protect his settlement. The rival leader Baek Mujin believes strict control is the only way to keep people alive. Clues slowly show what the countdown really means.
ending: The countdown ends not as destruction but as a selection; Doyun proves trust and planning beat control, Mujin finally understands, and a new dawn begins.

hero.face: same face every time: 19-year-old Korean-style boy, short messy dark-brown hair, small scar on the chin, dark circles under tired eyes

cast_hi: हान दोयुन (हीरो, लड़का, जो लीडर नहीं बनना चाहता), बैक मूजिन (दूसरी बस्ती का सख़्त लीडर, मुख्य प्रतिद्वंदी), ली सोयुन (बस्ती की इंजीनियर लड़की), बूढ़े डॉक्टर ओह (बस्ती के बुज़ुर्ग), दूसरा सूरज (आसमान का रहस्य)
outline: A second sun appears and a countdown of one hundred days shows in every settlement. In the panic Doyun's settlement leader dies, and Doyun, a scavenger who hates leadership, is left in charge of two hundred survivors.
Doyun discovers the first clue: the countdown number changes when people act together. He starts organizing the settlement.
An expedition for water and power cells meets strange creatures that only appear under the second sun.
Rival leader Baek Mujin arrives offering protection in exchange for total control. Doyun refuses.
Betrayal inside: someone is selling information to Mujin. Doyun finds out who and why.
An expedition into a ruined city finds a sealed bunker with a record about the catastrophe.
The creatures evolve and attack the settlement. Doyun uses traps and planning and loses a friend.
Mujin's settlement starves under his harsh rule. Doyun offers cooperation, but Mujin refuses because he sees the countdown as proof he is right.
A fragment of truth: the countdown is not an end but a selection.
Cliffhanger: the countdown suddenly jumps ahead. Someone is controlling it, and a signal comes from the sky.
